name: visits-checklists-readiness-escalations

tasks.objective: Re-prove governed field operational state machines and repair only reproduced root defects.

tasks.action: Trace handlers/db/controllers/tabs, add missing tests, exercise concurrency and restart, remove any obsolete parallel readiness state discovered, and preserve the current governed design when it passes.
mustNotChange: لا إعادة بناء state machine الناجحة من الصفر.
acceptanceCriteria: Operations tabs وPartner readback تعرض نفس readiness.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix state machine; never rollback by weakening completion/authorization constraints.
